resources.string: Enable and select in keyboard list, turn on feature
Set Samsung Keyboard voice input to \'Google voice typing\'
Whisper dictation from the Samsung Keyboard mic

Tap the mic on Samsung Keyboard and Whisper (OpenAI\'s speech recognition, which runs on your phone and never sends recordings out) types what you say, then returns to Samsung Keyboard when you finish.
✓ All set. Tap the Samsung Keyboard mic in any text field to start.
Setup %1$s/%2$s · Follow the steps below in order.
Try it here: tap, then the mic
GOAT handles \'Auto\' steps for you. Only the step you need to do now is expanded.
Tap the button below to open the Play Store. Tap [Install], then come back to GOAT when it\'s done. GOAT takes over the next step when you return.
You turned the feature off, so it wasn\'t turned on automatically. Turn on the top switch.
GOAT is enabling Whisper input in the keyboard list, selecting it as the redirect target, and turning on the feature. Wait a few seconds.
Tap the button below to open the Whisper input app (FUTO Voice Input). When asked for microphone permission, tap [Allow] and come back to GOAT.

The default model only transcribes English. Use the button below to open the Whisper input app, then download a model that includes Korean (Multilingual) under Languages. It takes 1–2 min on Wi-Fi. Screen names may vary slightly by version. When it\'s done, tap [Downloaded].

Tap the button below to open keyboard settings. ① Tap \'Samsung Keyboard\', ② tap \'Voice input\', then ③ choose \'Google voice typing\'. If left on Samsung voice input, the mic is handled inside the keyboard and GOAT can\'t redirect it to Whisper. After choosing, test it in the next step.

Tap the text field below, then tap the mic on Samsung Keyboard. If the Whisper screen appears, it worked and this step gets a ✓. When you finish speaking, the text goes into the field and Samsung Keyboard comes back on its own.
Tap here, then tap the Samsung Keyboard mic
Advanced: choose input method, check it works
Install a Whisper voice input app (FUTO Voice Input, WhisperInput, etc.), then choose it. Input methods with a voice mode are listed first.
Samsung voice input registered as a separate input method (not needed if set to \'Google voice typing\')
Redirect input method chosen and enabled
Switches to voice input when the mic is tapped (log below, excluding switches made by GOAT\'s test button)
1) Tap [Start Log], 2) tap the Samsung Keyboard mic in a text field in any app, then 3) come back here and tap [Stop Log]. It checks whether the input method switches when the mic is tapped.
Switch test: checks whether GOAT can switch the current input method to the one you chose.
Choose a redirect input method first.
Didn\'t switch (check that it\'s on in the keyboard list)
Samsung Keyboard mic opens Whisper input directly → OK (no redirect needed)
Switched to voice input when mic was tapped → Redirect possible

Input method didn\'t switch when mic was tapped → If Samsung Keyboard voice input is set to \'Samsung voice input\', it\'s handled inside the keyboard and can\'t be redirected. Switch to \'Google voice typing\' and log again
